nodes.description: Disease-associated TUBB1 alleles do not have one uniform molecular effect. Several missense proteins fail to incorporate into microtubules, whereas p.Arg359Trp partly incorporates and has a weaker distribution defect; truncating alleles are also reported. The shared consequence across functionally tested alleles is disturbed beta-1-tubulin organization or dosage, not a universal simple loss-of-function mechanism.
